question: The Ministry of Education approved a new scheme “New India Literacy Programme’ in February 2022 to cover all the features of ________ education.
solution:
The correct answer is __**elementary.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **New India Literacy Programme **aims to cover all the features of **elementary education**, which includes the **first eight years of schooling** from the age of **six.**
 
• The programme is designed to ensure that every child in India receives** quality education** and is able to** read, write, and comprehend** basic concepts by the time they complete their elementary education.
 
• The programme will focus on improving the** quality of education **in government schools, providing **teacher training**, and promoting **digital literacy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pre-primary education **refers to education for children **below the age of six, **while **adult education** is for individuals who have not completed their basic education.
 
• **Special education** is for students with **disabilities or special needs.**
 
• In **1995, the Mid-Day Meal Scheme** was introduced.
 
 
• Children in **primary and upper primary classes** at government, government-aided, and local body schools are eligible for free hot cooked meals.
 
• The program's objectives include **reducing childhood malnutrition **and enhancing children's** enrollment, retention, and attendance** in schools.
